import glob
import os
from pathlib import Path


def read_file(path="", task="", max_lines=100, **kwargs) -> str:
    if not path:
        path = _extract_path(task) or ""
    if not path:
        return "❌ 請提供檔案路徑"

    TEXT_EXTENSIONS = {
        ".txt", ".md", ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".json", ".yaml", ".yml",
        ".toml", ".ini", ".cfg", ".env", ".html", ".css", ".xml",
        ".csv", ".log", ".sh", ".bat", ".ps1", ".sql", ".rs", ".go",
        ".java", ".c", ".cpp", ".h", ".rb", ".php",
    }
    try:
        p = Path(path)
        if not p.exists():
            return f"檔案不存在：{path}"
        if not p.is_file():
            return f"這不是一個檔案：{path}"

        if p.suffix.lower() not in TEXT_EXTENSIONS:
            return (
                f"⚠️ 無法讀取二進位檔案：{p.name}（{_fmt_size(p.stat().st_size)}）\n"
                f"支援格式：{', '.join(sorted(TEXT_EXTENSIONS))}"
            )
        if p.stat().st_size > 500_000:
            return f"⚠️ 檔案太大（{_fmt_size(p.stat().st_size)}），請指定較小的檔案"

        content = None
        for enc in ["utf-8", "utf-8-sig", "big5", "gbk", "latin-1"]:
            try:
                content = p.read_text(encoding=enc)
                break
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                continue
        if content is None:
            return "❌ 無法解碼檔案（嘗試了多種編碼）"

        lines      = content.splitlines()
        total      = len(lines)
        max_lines  = int(max_lines)
        truncated  = ""
        if total > max_lines:
            content   = "\n".join(lines[:max_lines])
            truncated = f"\n\n... 檔案共 {total} 行，僅顯示前 {max_lines} 行"

        return (
            f"📄 <b>{p.name}</b>（{_fmt_size(p.stat().st_size)}，{total} 行）\n\n"
            f"<pre>{content}</pre>{truncated}"
        )
    except PermissionError:
        return f"❌ 無權讀取：{path}"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 讀取失敗：{e}"


def _fmt_size(size: int) -> str:
    for unit in ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"]:
        if size < 1024:
            return f"{size:.1f} {unit}"
        size /= 1024
    return f"{size:.1f} TB"


def _extract_path(task: str) -> str:
    """從自然語言中嘗試抓出路徑"""
    import re
    for pat in [
        r'[A-Z]:[\\\/][^\s，。,]+',
        r'\/[^\s，。,]+',
        r'[\w\-]+(?:[\\\/][\w\-\.]+)+',
    ]:
        m = re.search(pat, task)
        if m:
            return m.group().rstrip("/\\,。，")
    return ""
